home.title: How it works
home.text: ODIN utilizes state-of-the-art eye-tracking software to capture precise ocular metrics during our assessments, which are then fed into our advanced machine-learning algorithms for accurate and comprehensive user evaluation.

home.name: steps
home.kicker: From the sideline to a result
home.title: How an assessment works

items.title: Put on the headset
items.text: The portable headset is ready at the point of care, right where the athlete is.

items.title: Take the visual test
items.text: Eye-tracking software captures precise ocular metrics while the athlete's eyes follow what is on the screen.

items.title: Let the AI read it
items.text: Machine-learning algorithms turn those metrics into an accurate, comprehensive evaluation.

items.title: Share clear results
items.text: Interpretable results reach medical professionals, parents and coaches in real time.

home.name: demo
home.title: Follow the dot
home.text: Press start, then follow the glowing dot with your mouse or finger for a few seconds. Your path is drawn over the dot's path, the way eye tracking compares where the eyes go with where the target went. This is a demonstration of the idea, not a medical test.

items.title: Close to the dot
items.text: How much of the time your path stayed close to the moving dot.

about.name: mission
about.text:
At ODIN Diagnostics we are committed to making a significant leap forward in brain health. Our team comprises a diverse group of interdisciplinary engineers, entrepreneurs, and athletes united by a shared passion for creating a safer future and driving meaningful change.

We understand the complexities of concussions and are committed to addressing these challenges head-on. Our mission is to redefine concussion care to preserve brain health. We aim to prevent further damage after injury through early detection and intervention and by guiding evidence-based treatments to reduce long-term effects.

We are driven to make a lasting impact and enhance safety across all areas where brain injuries occur.
